description: This file implements the TR181 API functions for parameter get/set/clear operations, including local parameter management with file storage and semaphore synchronization, as well as error handling and logging.

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Retrieves parameter value via RFC, populates TR181_ParamData_t.

methods.name: clearParam
methods.description: Clears parameter via RFC by setting a special clear parameter.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Reads parameter value from a file.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves default parameter value from default config file.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Stores parameter value in local store file with semaphore protection.

methods.name: getLocalParam
methods.description: Gets local parameter with semaphore synchronization, falls back to default.

methods.name: setLocalParam
methods.description: Sets local parameter with semaphore synchronization.

methods.name: clearLocalParam
methods.description: Clears local parameter with semaphore synchronization.
